name: 新しいグループの会話開始カード
prompt:
Create one crisp, clean 390 × 354 px Japanese mobile component that matches the native preview exactly. The native Japanese preview is the ground truth for composition, copy, colors, type, and visible state. Use the original English source crop only to confirm meaning. Flat white background; no phone frame, no extra UI. Preserve the preview’s compact mobile hierarchy and generous but deliberate separation between the avatar, heading, subtitle, action text, and two controls.

Outer card: x=24,y=8,w=342,h=330; white fill, 1 px quiet border #E8ECE9, 12 px corners. Canvas background white. At x=164,y=24, show the native Japanese avatar placeholder: a 62 px circle filled #D1FAE5 with centered dark-green 「光」 in Meiryo Bold 14 px. Use this native monogram; do not substitute the source crop’s Statue of Liberty photo.

Centered heading in a 310 px text box at x=40,y=116,h=28: 「グループを作成しました」, Meiryo Bold 20 px, line height 28 px, #1D1D1D. Subtitle in the same centered width at x=40,y=156,h=24: 「グループ・メンバー3人」, Meiryo Regular 14 px, line height 24 px, #6E6E6E. At x=40,y=198,h=24, centered 「説明を追加」 in Meiryo Bold 14 px, line height 24 px, green #047857. This is a native in-app edit action, not a blue hyperlink.

Button 1: rounded pill x=40,y=244,w=310,h=32 with #ECFDF5 fill and 16 px radius; centered label 「メンバーを追加」 in Meiryo Regular 12 px, line height 16 px, dark green #064E3B. Button 2: same shape and color at x=40,y=290,w=310,h=32; centered label 「リンクやコードで招待」 in Meiryo Regular 12 px, line height 16 px, dark green #064E3B. The invite label is contained in an action button, not a hyperlink. The source chain-link icon belongs to that English button; the Japanese native preview omits the icon, so do not add one. Keep all text exactly as written. Do not add blue or underlined text, any extra copy, badges, shadows, artwork, icons, or decoration.
reviewNotes: v001 preserves Japanese text, the mint avatar and buttons, and native green action colors; no visible hyperlink. Residuals: card begins near y=24 and ends near y=331 instead of y=8..338 (about 23 px too short); avatar sits ~19 px low, heading/subtitle ~8-9 px low, and buttons sit ~4-8 px high. Use the final attempt to restore exact vertical anchors and card height.
